description: Get real-time financing rates from 4,200 credit unions across all 50 states—covering mortgages, auto loans, HELOCs, personal loans, and credit cards. RateAPI delivers personalized recommendations based on your location, loan amount, and credit profile, with interactive comparisons and rate monitoring. Unlike estimate-based calculators, every rate comes from actual credit union data, helping you find competitive offers that traditional rate sites often miss.

defaultPrompt: What are the best mortgage rates for a $400,000 home purchase in California
